description: This file defines data structures and functions for managing in-memory sessions related to data processing, including creating, retrieving, deleting, and listing sessions, as well as handling session-related errors.

classes.name: ProcessedResult
classes.description: Represents processed dataset results for a session, including statistics, data points, and anomalies.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Represents a single in-memory processing session with metadata, data points, and anomalies.

methods.name: create_session
methods.description: Creates and stores a new session from processed results.

methods.name: get_session
methods.description: Retrieves a session by its ID.

methods.name: delete_session
methods.description: Deletes a session by its ID.

methods.name: clear_all_sessions
methods.description: Deletes all sessions and returns the number of sessions deleted.

methods.name: list_sessions_preview
methods.description: Returns a small preview list of sessions for debugging purposes.

methods.name: _utc_now_iso
methods.description: Returns the current UTC time in ISO format.
